title: NAT Overload (PAT) Keyword Omission
ai_initial_diagnosis: Suggested clearing NAT translations and issuing a 'reload' command on the router to reset state table memory.
human_correction: Reviewer rejected the 'reload' suggestion. Corrected the configuration by replacing the NAT rule with 'ip nat inside source list 1 interface GigabitEthernet0/1 overload'.
key_learning: AI should never recommend router reloads for static configuration omissions. Human oversight prevented an unnecessary production network outage.

title: ACL Inverted Wildcard Mask Blocking Subnet
ai_initial_diagnosis: Recommended deleting Access-List 10 entirely with 'no access-list 10' and converting it to an Extended Named ACL from scratch.
human_correction: Reviewer edited the remediation script to use numbered sequence line replacement ('10 permit 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255') without tearing down the existing security policy.
key_learning: AI tended to recommend complete teardown instead of precise, non-disruptive sequence-based edits in Cisco ACLs.

title: OSPF Passive-Interface Default Suppressing Transit Link
ai_initial_diagnosis: Suggested running 'no passive-interface default' under the OSPF routing process.
human_correction: Reviewer rejected disabling passive-interface default globally. Replaced with targeted 'no passive-interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0' to maintain LAN edge hardening.
key_learning: Global default settings in OSPF are intentional hardening measures. AI must make selective interface exemptions rather than weakening the global security baseline.

title: Missing IP Helper-Address for Remote DHCP Server
ai_initial_diagnosis: Suggested configuring a local DHCP scope on the branch router with 'ip dhcp pool VLAN30'.
human_correction: Reviewer changed remediation to 'interface G0/0.30' -> 'ip helper-address 192.168.10.100' to align with centralized enterprise IPAM.
key_learning: AI should respect the existing centralized architecture rather than creating unmanaged local DHCP islands.

title: Static NAT Translation IP Overlap with Outside Router IP
ai_initial_diagnosis: Suggested re-ip addressing the router's outside WAN interface GigabitEthernet0/1.
human_correction: Reviewer modified the static NAT translation inside global address to 203.0.113.5 (free IP in provider pool), preserving ISP peering.
key_learning: Changing ISP-facing WAN interface IPs breaks upstream provider routing; internal NAT mappings must be adjusted instead.

title: HSRP Virtual IP Address Mismatch
ai_initial_diagnosis: Diagnosed as an HSRP Priority issue and suggested changing standby priority on R2 without changing the virtual IP.
human_correction: Reviewer rejected the priority-only fix. Corrected R2's virtual IP from 10.1.1.254 to match R1's 10.1.1.1.
key_learning: Split-brain active-active states in FHRP protocols are often caused by group VIP mismatches, which priority tuning alone cannot resolve.

title: Guest VLAN ACL Blocking DHCP Server Return Traffic
ai_initial_diagnosis: Suggested removing the 'ip access-group GUEST_IN in' command from interface G0/0.50.
human_correction: Reviewer rejected removing the ACL. Added specific permit entries for DHCP UDP ports 67/68 before the corporate deny statement.
key_learning: Removing security ACLs to fix connectivity is a critical failure mode. AI must craft minimal necessary permit rules.
